paper.title: Does spatial thinking ability relate to performance when using web-mapping services? A survey with digital natives

claims.claim: Total task scores: Google Maps versus HERE WeGo; Wilcoxon signed-rank V printed as 281.
Total task scores: Bing Maps versus HERE WeGo; Wilcoxon rank-sum W printed as 1036.
SUS scores: Google Maps versus HERE WeGo; paired t statistic printed as 9.45.
SUS scores: Bing Maps versus HERE WeGo; Wilcoxon rank-sum W printed as 1037.5.
Spatial-thinking ability and Google Maps task accuracy (STAT / TS GM); Kendall tau printed as 0.29.

results.note: The shipped script contains no Google Maps versus HERE WeGo total-task Wilcoxon test; its relevant Group 2 total-task comparison is omitted. No statistic was computed.

After the documented import fix, execution stops because the script never creates GMHWG$Sum_GM_Group2. Creating that score requires missing preprocessing, so the target test was not reached and no statistic was computed.
Execution stops before the shipped SUS analysis and paired t test are reached; no statistic was computed.
Execution stops before the shipped between-group SUS rank-sum test is reached; no statistic was computed.
Execution stops before STAT_GMCorrelation is reached; no correlation was computed.

findings.description: The script is not executable through its analysis section: it uses GMHWG$Sum_GM_Group2 without creating that column or the other Group 2 score variables. The shipped source omits this preprocessing, and the run terminates at the first missing field.
findings.evidence: logs/full_run.log ends with "Unknown or uninitialised column: `Sum_GM_Group2`" followed by an error in fligner.test.default; the run exits 1.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the original Group 2 preprocessing from the authors; no replacement was written for this check.

findings.description: The approved Google Maps versus HERE WeGo total-task Wilcoxon result is not implemented in the shipped script; it is among the Group 2 analyses described as omitted.
findings.evidence: survey_2021.R comments at the Group 2 section state that Group 1 tests are omitted for Group 2; no GM versus HERE WeGo total-task Wilcoxon test appears.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the authors’ original analysis code for this comparison.

limitations: No approved numeric result was computed because the shipped script stops before the target analyses.
The paper’s scientific conclusions were not assessed.
Original code and data are linked, not included in this certification bundle.
